coverageNotes: SCOPE. Gap-fill for 16 critic-named companies. None of them was already in the raw dataset under another name (checked by name/alias regex over all E*/G* files; 'Hitachi Energy' is a different company from Hitachi Vantara). 15 are recorded; Stellantis is LEFT OUT. METHOD. Official company location pages where they could be fetched (Temenos offices, Hitachi Vantara worldwide locations, Henkel India locations, Novartis India sites), Clarivate's contact page as surfaced in search results (direct fetch returns 403), press releases and trade press, and Built In Bengaluru job/company pages. Coordinates come from OSM building footprints where the building is mapped, park centroids where only a park is known (confidence held at medium), and street-centroid geocodes where only a street is known (stated in geocodeSource). The shared web-search budget ran out before the last Stellantis query. OMITTED: Stellantis. Its 50,000 sq ft Bengaluru software and technology centre (opened Oct 2022, STLA SmartCockpit lead site, ~500 hires planned, expanded Nov 2024) is confirmed, but no source found names its area, building or park, so it cannot be placed without inventing coordinates. PARTIAL. Henkel: the Global Technology Center (Apr 2022, 200+ staff by end-2022) and the March 2026 electronics application centre are confirmed in Bengaluru, but neither release names a site; only the Indiranagar address Henkel publishes is mapped. Hitachi Vantara: the official Bengaluru office is the Lavelle Road sales office; no Bengaluru R&D centre was found (Vantara's India HQ and engineering are in Hyderabad; the 2011 'Hitachi R&D Centre Bangalore' belonged to Hitachi India, and Hitachi High-Tech opened a separate Whitefield technical centre in 2025). T-Systems: Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is Gurugram-based with no Bengaluru site found; only T-Systems ICT India's Cessna Business Park office is recorded. WEAK EVIDENCE, flagged low. Novartis: only a directory listing (Raheja Chambers, Museum Road), and Novartis's own India page names no Bengaluru site. Verizon: Bengaluru presence is confirmed by Verizon, but both buildings come from user/directory sources (Prestige Tech Park; Torrey Pines at Embassy GolfLinks). Kantar: the current hub at Prestige Technology Park comes from one Sept 2026 job posting; the Kote M R Plaza and AMR Tech Park addresses are older listings that may have been superseded. NOT RECORDED. An aggregator address for PowerSchool at Salarpuria Softzone (likely pre-ETV), a Koramangala site for Credit Saison from a customer-care directory, and Hitachi India's WTC Bengaluru branch (a different Hitachi company). MERGE NOTE. Merck Group is also being researched in another chunk; the name 'Merck Group (Merck KGaA)' is kept exactly as briefed so the merge joins them. The MGCC coordinate is an OSM 'Merck' POI in Electronic City Phase 1 and may mark Merck's earlier Electronic City R&D site rather than the new campus. CATEGORIES. Credit Saison India is classed MNC/Foreign because its parent is Tokyo-based, though its own HQ is Bengaluru (isHq true). Zynga, Mercari and Hitachi Vantara are MNC subsidiaries of foreign groups (Take-Two, Mercari Inc., Hitachi).
